---
title: "Capacity & Demand — Overview"
subtitle: "Local analytics platform · data refreshed on pipeline run"
---

```{python}
import duckdb
import pandas as pd

con = duckdb.connect("../data/warehouse.duckdb", read_only=True)

demand = con.execute("""
    SELECT max(period_date) AS latest_week,
           sum(total_packages) FILTER (
               WHERE period_date = (SELECT max(period_date) FROM marts.demand_weekly)
           ) AS latest_week_packages
    FROM marts.demand_weekly
""").df()

capacity = con.execute("""
    SELECT max(period_date) AS latest_day,
           round(avg(utilization_pct) FILTER (
               WHERE period_date >= (SELECT max(period_date) - INTERVAL 7 DAY
                                     FROM marts.capacity_daily)
           ), 1) AS avg_utilization_7d
    FROM marts.capacity_daily
""").df()
con.close()
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
lw = demand["latest_week"].iloc[0]
lwp = demand["latest_week_packages"].iloc[0]
ld = capacity["latest_day"].iloc[0]
util = capacity["avg_utilization_7d"].iloc[0]
print(f"""
| KPI | Value |
|---|---|
| Latest demand week | **{lw}** |
| Packages in latest week (all regions) | **{lwp:,.0f}** |
| Latest capacity date | **{ld}** |
| Avg utilization, last 7 days | **{util}%** |
""")
```

## Demand trend (all regions)

```{python}
import plotly.express as px

con = duckdb.connect("../data/warehouse.duckdb", read_only=True)
df = con.execute("""
    SELECT period_date, region_name, total_packages
    FROM marts.demand_weekly ORDER BY period_date
""").df()
con.close()

fig = px.line(
    df, x="period_date", y="total_packages", color="region_name",
    labels={"period_date": "Week", "total_packages": "Packages", "region_name": "Region"},
)
fig.update_layout(height=420, legend_title=None)
fig.show()
```
